title: Colostomy and ileostomy care
what: A stoma is an opening of the bowel on the belly, through which stool passes into a special bag. You learn to change the bag and care for the skin yourself.
why: After bowel surgery, when the surgeon brought the bowel out to the belly, either for a time or permanently.
duration: changing the bag usually takes 10 to 20 minutes
tell_doctor: If the skin around the stoma is red, weeping or sore
If the stoma has changed color or size, or sticks out
If the stool is very watery, or there is none for more than a day

prepare.title: Supplies
prepare.text: Keep a stock of bags, plates and skin products. They are chosen with a stoma nurse.

prepare.title: Size
prepare.text: The hole in the plate is cut to the size of the stoma. In the first weeks the stoma shrinks, so measure again.

prepare.title: Timing
prepare.text: It is easier to change in the morning before eating, when the bowel is less active.

prepare.title: Place
prepare.text: Lay out everything you need in the bathroom on a clean towel.

bring: A stock of bags and plates
Discharge papers and the nurse's contact
steps: Wash your hands and get a new bag ready
Gently remove the old bag from top to bottom, holding the skin
Wash the skin around the stoma with warm water and pat dry
Look at the stoma and the skin around it
Cut the hole in the plate to the size of the stoma
Stick the plate on from the bottom up and hold it with your hand for 1 to 2 minutes
Put the used bag into a bag and throw it away
feel: The stoma itself does not hurt. It has no nerves, but it bleeds easily when touched
At first it feels strange and worrying. This is normal and gets easier
after: Empty the bag when it is one third to half full
Drink enough water, especially with an ileostomy
You can usually eat and wear almost anything. Ask your doctor about your own case
Do not lift heavy things. It protects against a hernia
red_flags: The stoma turns dark, blue or black: see a doctor urgently or call your local emergency number
Severe belly pain, vomiting and no stool: call your local emergency number
Very watery stool many times, weakness, little urine: see a doctor

faq.q: Can I shower with a stoma?
faq.a: Yes, with the bag on or off. Water will not get into the stoma.
Modern bags do not let odor through. A smell happens only during a change or a leak.

reminders.text: Bag change tomorrow morning. Check your stock of bags and plates.
